verdict.rationale: Docs confirm reschedule/cancel are first-class booking operations (reschedulable 'accepted'/'pending' statuses, seated bookings) and that BOOKING_RESCHEDULED/BOOKING_CANCELLED webhook triggers exist for downstream sync, plus calendar/conferencing connections (Cal Video, Zoom, Teams, Google Meet) that would reflect changes. However the pack never explicitly documents the invitee-facing confirmation-page self-service reschedule/cancel links or shows policy enforcement (e.g., cancellation windows, buffers) tied to that flow, nor explicit two-way calendar update confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit invitee confirmation-page reschedule/cancel UI evidence, explicit policy-enforcement details (min notice, cancellation rules) at the invitee-facing layer, and confirmation of two-way external calendar sync post-reschedule.
